title: Complete scoped owner workflow controls and live dashboard qualification
description: Existing Console supports several previewed actions and live refresh. Audit remaining desired owner controls (assignment/routing, lifecycle, integration and release views) against spec and current capabilities; implement only individually authorized operations. Qualify real provider activity and native background/back-cache refresh while preserving edits and private artifact provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Controls show target; effect; authority and current evidence before confirmation
Stale/replayed previews cannot modify a newer task or session
Live refresh and artifact review retain focused drafts and distinguish recorded from live state
